                Controlled Inspections for Illumination Levels of the
                Signs Required in the SPECIAL TIMES SQUARE AREA as per
                Section 81-732 of the Zoning Resolution.



Section 81-732 requires that no Temporary Certificate of Occupancy be
issued comprising in aggregate more than 50%, 90% and 100% of the
total floor area of the development or enlargement until 50%, 90%, and
100% respectively of the aggregate surface area of signs required
under Section 81-732(a)(3) has been installed and put in operation in
accordance with all of the requirements and standards as set forth in
Section 81-732(2)(3) and (a)(7).

Prior to the issuance of a Temporary or Final Certificate of Occupancy
for more than 50%, or for more than 90% or for 100% of the floor area,
architect or professional engineer acceptable by the applicant of
record shall submit a 10E Amendment Form for controlled inspection
attesting that the illumination levels for a percentage of the
required signs related to the percentage of the building for which the
Temporary Certificate of Occupancy is to be issued, meet the required
illumination standards as required by Section 81-732.
